xref.title: Early Life and Family Band
xref.body: Viola Smith was born in Wisconsin in 1912 and began playing drums at age 11. Her father ran a family band where each child was expected to pick up an instrument; drums became Viola's by default as all other instruments were taken. She started touring with the family band in the early 1920s. "Her father ran this band, featuring all the members of the family, and each kid was expected to pick up an instrument. And by the time he got to Viola, all the instruments were taken except the drums."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Pre-Music Career Paths
xref.body: Before Kings of Leon formed, the members had various paths. Nathan Followill was the only one to graduate from high school. Caleb Followill left school in grade 11 to pursue work as a construction worker, but he later quit this job to fully commit to music. Jared Followill, the youngest brother, "just tagged along" during the band's formation, becoming the bassist by default. "Nathan, being the oldest, graduated from high school first, Caleb bailed on school in grade 11 to become a construction worker. But then once he got deeper into music, he quit that too."
